meaning: Shared reusable QA and technical failures with proven repairs; recording insights is not model training.

lessons.specific_problem: Original Sandwich Harbour 08.jpg does not show ocean though copy promised dunes meet ocean
lessons.remedy_attempted: Replaced with free photographer-labelled Sandwich Harbour aerial showing both sand and sea
lessons.preventive_check: Before accepting cover, inspect original pixel content and compare image with headline noun/verb

lessons.specific_problem: Original image of exterior could not show sand-filled room claimed by overlay
lessons.remedy_attempted: Replaced with Francesco Ungaro free Kolmanskop interior with sand occupying room
lessons.preventive_check: For each page require image subject visibly matches the actual strongest specific experience; never rely on caption to fix mismatch

lessons.specific_problem: GitHub render run 42696108756 failed because activity_source was omitted
lessons.remedy_attempted: Added activity_source URLs listed in fact_sources for all slides; rerender 42696283143 passed
lessons.preventive_check: Run manifest validation and require all slides activity_source (and membership in fact_sources) before triggering GitHub rendering

lessons.specific_problem: Published Japan caption contained many nonessential caveats, multiple seasons, logistical detail and negative guarantees
lessons.remedy_attempted: Changed canonical editorial and review instructions to short, fun, inspiring captions with essential place/reward only
lessons.preventive_check: Reject copy dominated by disclaimers or lengthy directions, except for material access facts necessary to avoid misleading the visitor

lessons.specific_problem: Claimed whole Camargue wetlands turned pink though image showed individual pale birds, and claimed vulture soaring though photographed perched
lessons.remedy_attempted: Simplified overlays to real pictured activity: flamingos wading; vultures to look for in the park; re-rendered exact new copy and reviewed real output
lessons.preventive_check: For EVERY slide at QA explicitly compare action verbs, numbers and visual subject to photo; if a pictured bird is perched do not claim flying

lessons.specific_problem: Generic bland horizon with too little visible wildlife was not compelling enough as the final saveable visual
lessons.remedy_attempted: Several sourced replacement attempts, final actual Pexels-licensed Camargue flamingo group silhouettes in orange sunset, inspected full size
lessons.preventive_check: Last CTA must include an expressive actual place/subject scene and be visually distinctive rather than generic dusk stock photo; if weak, reject and replace before scheduling

lessons.specific_problem: One intermediate reviewer read manifest while brief's photo credits had changed; initial manifest had stale credit line
lessons.remedy_attempted: Updated correctly separated Unsplash and Pexels credit in source brief, renderer rerun 42699403303 succeeded, re-fetched exact current manifest and confirmed caption equality before scheduling
lessons.preventive_check: Require exact current brief-to-manifest caption match, exact source locations and SHA after EVERY copy edit or asset change, including minor credit fixes; never schedule stale assets
